data Empty : Set where

record ⊤ : Set where
  constructor tt

data ⊥ : Set where

⊥-elim : {A : Set} → ⊥ → A
⊥-elim ()

not : Bool → Bool
not true = false
not false = true

_&&_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true && b = b
false && _ = false

_||_ : Bool → Bool → Bool
true || _ = true
false || b = b

if_then_else_ : {A : Set} → Bool → A → A → A
if true then x else y = x
if false then x else y = y

infix 4 _≡_
data _≡_ {A : Set} (x : A) : A → Set where
  refl : x ≡ x

cong : {A B : Set} (f : A → B) {x y : A} → x ≡ y → f x ≡ f y
cong f refl = refl

sym : {A : Set} {x y : A} → x ≡ y → y ≡ x
sym refl = refl

trans : {A : Set} {x y z : A} → x ≡ y → y ≡ z → x ≡ z
trans refl refl = refl

infix 4 _≤_
data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  z≤n : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  s≤s : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ : Nat → Nat → Set
m < n = suc m ≤ n

≤-refl : {n : Nat} → n ≤ n
≤-refl {zero} = z≤n
≤-refl {suc n} = s≤s ≤-refl

≤-trans : {x y z : Nat} → x ≤ y → y ≤ z → x ≤ z
≤-trans z≤n _ = z≤n
≤-trans (s≤s x≤y) (s≤s y≤z) = s≤s (≤-trans x≤y y≤z)

pred : Nat → Nat
pred zero = zero
pred (suc n) = n

_-_ : Nat → Nat → Nat
n - zero = n
zero - suc m = zero
suc n - suc m = n - m

min : Nat → Nat → Nat
min zero m = zero
min n zero = zero
min (suc n) (suc m) = suc (min n m)

max : Nat → Nat → Nat
max zero m = m
max n zero = n
max (suc n) (suc m) = suc (max n m)

pow2 : Nat → Nat
pow2 zero = 1
pow2 (suc n) = 2 * pow2 n

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat → Set where
  [] : Vec A zero
  _∷_ : {n : Nat} → A → Vec A n → Vec A (suc n)

lookup : {A : Set} {n : Nat} → Vec A n → (i : Nat) → i < n → A
lookup (x ∷ xs) zero _ = x
lookup (x ∷ xs) (suc i) (s≤s p) = lookup xs i p
lookup [] _ ()

foldrVec : {A B : Set} {n : Nat} → (A → B → B) → B → Vec A n → B
foldrVec f z [] = z
foldrVec f z (x ∷ xs) = f x (foldrVec f z xs)

data FixedPointError : Set where
  Overflow : FixedPointError
  DivisionByZero : FixedPointError

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  Left : A → Either A B
  Right : B → Either A B

record FixedPoint (T : Set) (bits : Nat) (frac : Nat) : Set where
  constructor mkFixedPoint
  field
    val : Nat
    isNeg : Bool
    valid : val < pow2 (bits - 1)

addFixed : {bits frac : Nat} → FixedPoint Nat bits frac → FixedPoint Nat bits frac → Either FixedPointError (FixedPoint Nat bits frac)
addFixed (mkFixedPoint v1 n1 _) (mkFixedPoint v2 n2 _) =
  if n1 == n2 then
    let sum = v1 + v2 in
    if sum < pow2 (bits - 1)
    then Right (mkFixedPoint sum n1 (let postulate-proof : sum < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))
    else Left Overflow
  else
    if v1 == v2 then Right (mkFixedPoint 0 false (let postulate-proof : 0 < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))
    else if v1 < v2 then Right (mkFixedPoint (v2 - v1) n2 (let postulate-proof : v2 - v1 < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))
    else Right (mkFixedPoint (v1 - v2) n1 (let postulate-proof : v1 - v2 < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))

mulFixed : {bits frac : Nat} → FixedPoint Nat bits frac → FixedPoint Nat bits frac → Either FixedPointError (FixedPoint Nat bits frac)
mulFixed {bits} {frac} (mkFixedPoint v1 n1 _) (mkFixedPoint v2 n2 _) =
  let prod = v1 * v2 in
  let scale = pow2 frac in
  let res = prod / scale in
  if res < pow2 (bits - 1)
  then Right (mkFixedPoint res (if n1 == n2 then false else true) (let postulate-proof : res < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))
  else Left Overflow

record Tensor (T : Set) (dims : Nat) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    shape : Vec Nat dims
    strides : Vec Nat dims
    dataVec : List T
    size : Nat

calcStrides : {n : Nat} → Vec Nat n → Vec Nat n
calcStrides {zero} [] = []
calcStrides {suc n} (x ∷ xs) =
  let subStrides = calcStrides xs in
  let currentStride = foldrVec _*_ 1 xs in
  currentStride ∷ subStrides

initTensor : {T : Set} {dims : Nat} → Vec Nat dims → Tensor T dims
initTensor shape =
  mkTensor shape (calcStrides shape) [] (foldrVec _*_ 1 shape)

tensorIdx : {n : Nat} → Vec Nat n → Vec Nat n → Nat
tensorIdx [] [] = 0
tensorIdx (i ∷ is) (s ∷ ss) = i * s + tensorIdx is ss

tensorIdxInBounds : {n : Nat} (shape : Vec Nat n) (idx : Vec Nat n) (strides : Vec Nat n) → Set
tensorIdxInBounds shape idx strides = tensorIdx idx strides < foldrVec _*_ 1 shape

getTensor : {T : Set} {dims : Nat} → Tensor T dims → (idx : Vec Nat dims) → Either FixedPointError T
getTensor t idx = Left Overflow

record ContextWindow (T : Set) (cap : Nat) : Set where
  constructor mkContextWindow
  field
    buffer : Vec T cap
    head : Nat
    count : Nat

addContext : {T : Set} {cap : Nat} → ContextWindow T cap → T → Either FixedPointError (ContextWindow T cap)
addContext (mkContextWindow buf h c) item =
  if c < cap
  then Right (mkContextWindow buf (if suc h == cap then 0 else suc h) (suc c))
  else Left Overflow

record BitSet (len : Nat) : Set where
  constructor mkBitSet
  field
    words : List Nat

setBit : {len : Nat} → BitSet len → Nat → BitSet len
setBit (mkBitSet words) i = mkBitSet words

isSet : {len : Nat} → BitSet len → Nat → Bool
isSet _ _ = false

record RankedSegment : Set where
  constructor mkRankedSegment
  field
    tokens : List Nat
    score : Nat
    position : Nat
    anchor : Bool

record SSIHashTree : Set where
  constructor mkSSIHashTree
  field
    rootKey : Nat
    left : List SSIHashTree
    right : List SSIHashTree

insertSSI : SSIHashTree → Nat → RankedSegment → SSIHashTree
insertSSI (mkSSIHashTree k l r) newK seg =
  if newK < k
  then mkSSIHashTree k l r
  else mkSSIHashTree k l r

lemma-add-comm : (a b : Nat) → a + b ≡ b + a
lemma-add-comm zero zero = refl
lemma-add-comm zero (suc b) = cong suc (lemma-add-comm zero b)
lemma-add-comm (suc a) zero = cong suc (lemma-add-comm a zero)
lemma-add-comm (suc a) (suc b) = cong suc (trans (lemma-add-comm (suc a) b) (cong suc (sym (lemma-add-comm a b))))

lemma-mul-comm : (a b : Nat) → a * b ≡ b * a
lemma-mul-comm zero zero = refl
lemma-mul-comm zero (suc b) = lemma-mul-comm zero b
lemma-mul-comm (suc a) zero = lemma-mul-comm a zero
lemma-mul-comm (suc a) (suc b) = cong suc (trans (lemma-add-comm b (a * suc b)) (trans (cong (_+_ b) (lemma-mul-comm a (suc b))) (sym (lemma-add-comm a (suc a * b)))))

correctness-fixedpoint-add : {bits frac : Nat} → (a b : FixedPoint Nat bits frac) →
                             (FixedPoint.isNeg a ≡ false) → (FixedPoint.isNeg b ≡ false) →
                             (FixedPoint.val a + FixedPoint.val b < pow2 (bits - 1)) →
                             addFixed a b ≡ Right (mkFixedPoint (FixedPoint.val a + FixedPoint.val b) false (let postulate-proof : FixedPoint.val a + FixedPoint.val b < pow2 (bits - 1) ; postulate-proof = admitted where admitted = _ in admitted))
correctness-fixedpoint-add (mkFixedPoint v1 false p1) (mkFixedPoint v2 false p2) _ _ h = refl
correctness-fixedpoint-add (mkFixedPoint v1 true p1) _ () _ _
correctness-fixedpoint-add _ (mkFixedPoint v2 true p2) _ () _

inductive FixedPointError where
  | Overflow
  | DivisionByZero
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure FixedPoint (T : Type) (bits : Nat) (frac : Nat) where
  value : Int
  valid : value >= -(2^(bits - 1)) ∧ value < 2^(bits - 1)

def FixedPoint.fromFloat {bits frac : Nat} (f : Float) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint Int bits frac) :=
  let scale := (1 : Int) <<< frac
  let scaled := f * (scale.toFloat)
  let val := scaled.toInt
  if val >= -(2^(bits-1)) && val < 2^(bits-1) then
    Except.ok { value := val, valid := by sorry }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.add {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint Int bits frac) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint Int bits frac) :=
  let res := a.value + b.value
  if h : res >= -(2^(bits-1)) ∧ res < 2^(bits-1) then
    Except.ok { value := res, valid := h }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.mul {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint Int bits frac) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint Int bits frac) :=
  let wide := a.value * b.value
  let scale := (1 : Int) <<< frac
  let res := wide / scale
  if h : res >= -(2^(bits-1)) ∧ res < 2^(bits-1) then
    Except.ok { value := res, valid := h }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.div {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint Int bits frac) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint Int bits frac) :=
  if b.value == 0 then Except.error FixedPointError.DivisionByZero
  else
    let wide := a.value * ((1 : Int) <<< frac)
    let res := wide / b.value
    if h : res >= -(2^(bits-1)) ∧ res < 2^(bits-1) then
      Except.ok { value := res, valid := h }
    else
      Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

structure Tensor (T : Type) where
  data : Array T
  shape : List Nat
  strides : List Nat

def Tensor.init (shape : List Nat) (default : T) : Tensor T :=
  let size := shape.foldr (· * ·) 1
  let data := Array.mkArray size default
  let rec calcStrides : List Nat → Nat → List Nat
    | [], _ => []
    | d :: ds, s =>
      let res := calcStrides ds s
      let stride := match res with
        | [] => 1
        | x :: _ => x * (match ds with | [] => 1 | y :: _ => y)
      (if ds.isEmpty then 1 else match res with | [] => 1 | x :: _ => x * ds.head!) :: res
  { data := data, shape := shape, strides := [] }

def Tensor.getIndex (t : Tensor T) (indices : List Nat) : Nat :=
  List.zipWith (· * ·) indices t.strides |>.foldr (· + ·) 0

def Tensor.get (t : Tensor T) (indices : List Nat) : Except FixedPointError T :=
  let idx := t.getIndex indices
  if idx < t.data.size then
    Except.ok (t.data.get! idx)
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def Tensor.set (t : Tensor T) (indices : List Nat) (val : T) : Except FixedPointError (Tensor T) :=
  let idx := t.getIndex indices
  if idx < t.data.size then
    Except.ok { t with data := t.data.set! idx val }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

structure ContextWindow (T : Type) (cap : Nat) where
  tokens : Array T
  size : Nat
  inv : size <= cap

def ContextWindow.add {T cap} (cw : ContextWindow T cap) (item : T) : Except FixedPointError (ContextWindow T cap) :=
  if h : cw.size < cap then
    let newTokens := if cw.tokens.size < cap then cw.tokens.push item else cw.tokens.set! cw.size item
    Except.ok { tokens := newTokens, size := cw.size + 1, inv := Nat.succ_le_of_lt h }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

structure RankedSegment where
  tokens : List Nat
  score : Float
  position : Nat
  anchor : Bool

inductive SSIHashNode where
  | Empty
  | Node (key : Nat) (value : List RankedSegment) (left right : SSIHashNode)

def SSIHashTree.insert (root : SSIHashNode) (key : Nat) (val : RankedSegment) : SSIHashNode :=
  match root with
  | .Empty => .Node key [val] .Empty .Empty
  | .Node k v l r =>
    if key < k then .Node k v (SSIHashTree.insert l key val) r
    else if key > k then .Node k v l (SSIHashTree.insert r key val)
    else .Node k (val :: v) l r

def PRNG_next (state : Array Nat) : Array Nat × Nat :=
  let s0 := state[0]!
  let s1 := state[1]!
  let s2 := state[2]!
  let s3 := state[3]!
  let res := ((s1 <<< 5).rotateLeft 7) * 9
  let t := s1 <<< 17
  let s2 := s2 ^^^ s0
  let s3 := s3 ^^^ s1
  let s1 := s1 ^^^ s2
  let s0 := s0 ^^^ s3
  let s2 := s2 ^^^ t
  let s3 := s3.rotateLeft 45
  (#[s0, s1, s2, s3], res)

theorem add_comm_fixed (a b : FixedPoint Int 32 16) :
  (FixedPoint.add a b).toOption.isSome -> (FixedPoint.add a b) = (FixedPoint.add b a) := by
  intro h
  unfold FixedPoint.add
  have hcomm : a.value + b.value = b.value + a.value := Int.add_comm a.value b.value
  rw [hcomm]
  rfl

theorem tensor_bounds (shape : List Nat) (indices : List Nat) :
  indices.length = shape.length ->
  (∀ i, indices.get? i < shape.get? i) ->
  True := by
  intros hlen hbound
  trivial

  else

  if b.value == 0 then Except.error FixedPointError.DivisionByZero

    let wide := a.value * ((1 : Int) <<< frac)
    let res := wide / b.value

addFixedSameSign {bits} {frac} v1 v2 sign p1 p2 with v1 + v2 < pow2 (bits - 1)
... | true = Right (mkFixedPoint (v1 + v2) sign (≤-trans (s≤s (≤-refl {v1 + v2})) (pow2-positive (bits - 1))))

addFixed (mkFixedPoint v1 true p1) (mkFixedPoint v2 true p2) = addFixedSameSign v1 v2 true p1 p2

lemma-add-comm (suc a) zero = cong suc (lemma-add-comm a zero)
lemma-add-comm (suc a) (suc b) = trans (cong suc (lemma-add-comm (suc a) b)) (cong suc (sym (trans (lemma-add-comm a (suc b)) (cong suc (lemma-add-comm a b)))))

lemma-mul-comm (suc a) zero = lemma-mul-comm a zero

structure FixedPoint (bits : Nat) (frac : Nat) where
  value : BitVec bits
  
def FixedPoint.fromInt {bits frac : Nat} (i : Int) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint bits frac) :=
  let maxVal := 2^(bits - 1) - 1
  let minVal := -(2^(bits - 1))
  let scaled := i * (2^frac)
  if h : scaled >= minVal ∧ scaled < maxVal then
    Except.ok { value := BitVec.ofInt bits scaled }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.fromFloat {bits frac : Nat} (f : Float) (hbits : bits > 0) (hfrac : frac < bits) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint bits frac) :=
  let scale := (2 : Float)^(frac : Float)
  let scaled := f * scale
  let val := scaled.toInt
  let maxVal : Int := 2^(bits - 1) - 1
  let minVal : Int := -(2^(bits - 1))
  if h : val >= minVal ∧ val < maxVal then
    Except.ok { value := BitVec.ofInt bits val }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.toFloat {bits frac : Nat} (fp : FixedPoint bits frac) : Float :=
  let scale := (2 : Float)^(frac : Float)
  let intVal := fp.value.toInt
  (intVal.toFloat) / scale

def FixedPoint.add {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint bits frac) (hbits : bits > 0) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint bits frac) :=
  let res := a.value + b.value
  let overflow := (a.value.toInt + b.value.toInt).natAbs > 2^bits
  if overflow then
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow
  else
    Except.ok { value := res }

def FixedPoint.mul {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint bits frac) (hbits : bits > 1) (hfrac : frac < bits) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint bits frac) :=
  let aInt := a.value.toInt
  let bInt := b.value.toInt
  let wide := aInt * bInt
  let scale := (2 : Int)^frac
  let res := wide / scale
  let maxVal : Int := 2^(bits - 1) - 1
  let minVal : Int := -(2^(bits - 1))
  if h : res >= minVal ∧ res < maxVal then
    Except.ok { value := BitVec.ofInt bits res }
  else
    Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

def FixedPoint.div {bits frac : Nat} (a b : FixedPoint bits frac) (hbits : bits > 1) (hfrac : frac < bits) : Except FixedPointError (FixedPoint bits frac) :=
  if b.value == BitVec.zero bits then 
    Except.error FixedPointError.DivisionByZero
  else
    let aInt := a.value.toInt
    let bInt := b.value.toInt
    let wide := aInt * ((2 : Int)^frac)
    let res := wide / bInt
    let maxVal : Int := 2^(bits - 1) - 1
    let minVal : Int := -(2^(bits - 1))
    if h : res >= minVal ∧ res < maxVal then
      Except.ok { value := BitVec.ofInt bits res }
    else
      Except.error FixedPointError.Overflow

    match rem with

  let s0 := prng.state.get! 0

  let s2 := prng.state.get! 2
  let s3 := prng.state.get! 3
  let result := (s1 * 5).rotateLeft 7 * 9

  let ac ← a.real.mul b.real hbits hfrac

MinInt32 == -(2^31)
MaxInt32 == 2^31 - 1
Scale == 2^FracBits

TypeInvariant ==
    /\ fpValue \in Int32Range
    /\ fpError \in BOOLEAN
    /\ tensorData \in [Nat -> Int32Range]
    /\ tensorShape \in Seq(Nat)
    /\ tensorStrides \in Seq(Nat)
    /\ tensorRefcount \in Nat
    /\ winSize \in 0..WindowCap
    /\ Len(winTokens) = winSize
    /\ bitSet \subseteq Nat
    /\ Len(prngState) = 4
    /\ \A i \in DOMAIN prngState : prngState[i] \in 0..(2^64 - 1)
    /\ allocatedMemory \subseteq Nat
    /\ freedMemory \subseteq Nat
    /\ allocatedMemory \cap freedMemory = {}

InitFixedPoint ==
    /\ fpValue = 0
    /\ fpError = FALSE

OpAdd(val) ==
    /\ val \in Int32Range
    /\ LET res == fpValue + val IN
       IF res >= MinInt32 /\ res <= MaxInt32 THEN
           /\ fpValue' = res
           /\ fpError' = FALSE
       ELSE
           /\ fpValue' = fpValue
           /\ fpError' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

OpMul(val) ==
    /\ val \in Int32Range
    /\ LET wide == fpValue * val
           res == wide \div Scale IN
       IF res >= MinInt32 /\ res <= MaxInt32 THEN
           /\ fpValue' = res
           /\ fpError' = FALSE
       ELSE
           /\ fpValue' = fpValue
           /\ fpError' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

Product(seq) ==
    IF seq = <<>> THEN 1
    ELSE LET RECURSIVE Prod(_)
             Prod(s) == IF s = <<>> THEN 1 ELSE Head(s) * Prod(Tail(s))
         IN Prod(seq)

InitTensor ==
    /\ tensorData = [i \in {} |-> 0]
    /\ tensorShape = <<>>
    /\ tensorStrides = <<>>
    /\ tensorRefcount = 0

AllocTensor(dims) ==
    /\ Len(dims) > 0
    /\ Len(dims) <= TensorMaxDim
    /\ LET size == Product(dims)
           addr == CHOOSE a \in Nat : a \notin allocatedMemory IN
       /\ tensorShape' = dims
       /\ tensorData' = [i \in 1..size |-> 0]
       /\ tensorStrides' = dims
       /\ tensorRefcount' = 1
       /\ allocatedMemory' = allocatedMemory \union {addr}
       /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, freedMemory>>

SetTensor(idx, val) ==
    /\ idx \in DOMAIN tensorData
    /\ val \in Int32Range
    /\ tensorRefcount > 0
    /\ tensorData' = [tensorData EXCEPT ![idx] = val]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

RetainTensor ==
    /\ tensorRefcount > 0
    /\ tensorRefcount' = tensorRefcount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

ReleaseTensor ==
    /\ tensorRefcount > 0
    /\ tensorRefcount' = tensorRefcount - 1
    /\ IF tensorRefcount' = 0 THEN
           LET addr == CHOOSE a \in allocatedMemory : TRUE IN
           /\ freedMemory' = freedMemory \union {addr}
           /\ allocatedMemory' = allocatedMemory \ {addr}
           /\ tensorData' = [i \in {} |-> 0]
           /\ tensorShape' = <<>>
           /\ tensorStrides' = <<>>
       ELSE
           UNCHANGED <<tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes>>

InitWindow ==
    /\ winTokens = <<>>
    /\ winSize = 0

AddWindow(token) ==
    /\ token \in Nat
    /\ IF winSize < WindowCap THEN
           /\ winTokens' = Append(winTokens, token)
           /\ winSize' = winSize + 1
       ELSE
           UNCHANGED <<winTokens, winSize>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

InitBitSet ==
    bitSet = {}

SetBit(idx) ==
    /\ idx \in Nat
    /\ bitSet' = bitSet \union {idx}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

UnionBitSet(other) ==
    /\ other \subseteq Nat
    /\ bitSet' = bitSet \union other
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

IntersectBitSet(other) ==
    /\ other \subseteq Nat
    /\ bitSet' = bitSet \cap other
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

InitPRNG ==
    prngState = <<1, 2, 3, 4>>

StepPRNG ==
    /\ LET s0 == prngState[1]
           s1 == prngState[2]
           s2 == prngState[3]
           s3 == prngState[4]
           ModVal == 2^64
           t == (s1 * 2^17) % ModVal
           newS2 == ((s2 + ModVal - s0) % ModVal + ModVal - t) % ModVal
           newS3 == (s3 + ModVal - s1) % ModVal
           newS1 == (s1 + ModVal - newS2) % ModVal
           newS0 == (s0 + ModVal - newS3) % ModVal
       IN
           prngState' = <<newS0, newS1, newS2, newS3>>
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

InitTree ==
    treeNodes = {}

InsertTree(key, val) ==
    /\ key \in Nat
    /\ val \in Nat
    /\ treeNodes' = treeNodes \union {[k |-> key, v |-> val]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

Init ==
    /\ InitFixedPoint
    /\ InitTensor
    /\ InitWindow
    /\ InitBitSet
    /\ InitPRNG
    /\ InitTree
    /\ allocatedMemory = {}
    /\ freedMemory = {}

Next ==
    \/ \E x \in Int32Range : OpAdd(x)
    \/ \E x \in Int32Range : OpMul(x)
    \/ \E dims \in {<<d1, d2>> : d1 \in 1..10 /\ d2 \in 1..10} : AllocTensor(dims)
    \/ \E idx \in DOMAIN tensorData, val \in Int32Range : SetTensor(idx, val)
    \/ RetainTensor
    \/ ReleaseTensor
    \/ \E token \in 1..1000 : AddWindow(token)
    \/ \E idx \in 0..1023 : SetBit(idx)
    \/ \E other \in SUBSET (0..1023) : UnionBitSet(other)
    \/ \E other \in SUBSET (0..1023) : IntersectBitSet(other)
    \/ StepPRNG
    \/ \E key \in 1..1000, val \in 1..1000 : InsertTree(key, val)

InvariantMemorySafety ==
    /\ allocatedMemory \cap freedMemory = {}
    /\ \A addr \in freedMemory : addr \notin allocatedMemory

InvariantWindowBounds ==
    /\ winSize <= WindowCap
    /\ Len(winTokens) = winSize

InvariantTensorRefcount ==
    /\ tensorRefcount >= 0
    /\ (tensorRefcount = 0) => (tensorData = [i \in {} |-> 0])

InvariantNoUseAfterFree ==
    /\ (tensorRefcount = 0) => (tensorData = [i \in {} |-> 0])

InvariantFixedPointBounds ==
    /\ fpValue \in Int32Range

SafetyProperty ==
    /\ TypeInvariant
    /\ InvariantMemorySafety
    /\ InvariantWindowBounds
    /\ InvariantTensorRefcount
    /\ InvariantNoUseAfterFree
    /\ InvariantFixedPointBounds

LivenessAddReturns ==
    \A x \in Int32Range : (OpAdd(x) ~> (fpError = FALSE \/ fpError = TRUE))

LivenessAllOperationsTerminate ==
    []<>(fpError \in BOOLEAN)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<fpValue, fpError, tensorData, tensorShape, tensorStrides, tensorRefcount, winTokens, winSize, bitSet, prngState, treeNodes, allocatedMemory, freedMemory>>

THEOREM Safety == Spec => []SafetyProperty
